page_title: NEW 3-0 IPS | Newcastle v Ipswich 26/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' CLOSE! Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the right post!
90+4' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

90+2' William Osula (Newcastle Utd) goes on a great individual run, arrives at the edge of the box and pulls the trigger. It was a promising effort which would have most likely gone past the goalkeeper if it hadn't been deflected by another offensive player.

90+1' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. But his low attempt from just outside of the box went straight towards the middle of the goal and Alex Palmer made a comfortable save.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) latches onto the ball in the penalty box and takes a first-time effort that goes a couple of yards over the crossbar.
86' Here is a change. Jack Taylor is going off and Kieran McKenna gives the last tactical orders to Massimo Luongo (Ipswich).
86' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Newcastle was in an offside position.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) is coming onto the pitch as Fabian Schar cannot continue after picking up an injury.
83' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
80' 3 - 0 Kieran Trippier takes the corner and William Osula (Newcastle Utd) rises highest near the penalty spot to plant a brilliant header into the top right corner. The score is 3:0.
80' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner.
79' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Newcastle force their opponents to concede a corner.
77' It's time for a substitution. William Osula comes on in place of Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd).
77' Today's match ends for Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) who will be replaced by Callum Wilson.
77' The ball possession is 78:22.
71' That's the end of the game for Julio Enciso, who is replaced by Conor Chaplin (Ipswich).
71' Kieran McKenna has decided to substitute Liam Delap and he is replaced by George Hirst (Ipswich).
71' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Newcastle players are visibly unhappy with the call.
71' Referee Michael Salisbury makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Newcastle. Let’s see what happens!
70' Surely that's handball by one of the Ipswich players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
67' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jacob Murphy walks off the pitch to be replaced by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd).
67' Eddie Howe decides to make a substitution. Joe Willock will be replaced by Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd).
64' Newcastle have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
63' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jacob Greaves (Ipswich) was quite harsh and Michael Salisbury didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
62' A quickly taken corner by Newcastle.
62' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. Newcastle earn a corner.
56' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) gets on the end of a pass and it allows him to finish into an empty net with a close-range header. The score has changed to 2:0.
56' The linesman points to the corner flag, Newcastle are going to take it.
56' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
53' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
49' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' 1 - 0 Goal! Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alex Palmer into the bottom right corner.
45+4' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) is going to take the penalty!
45+4' It’s a PENALTY to Newcastle after the VAR review!
45+2' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Newcastle! Let's see what he decides.
45+2' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
44' The yellow card is received by Liam Delap (Ipswich).
43' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
42' Newcastle failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
42' Newcastle quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
42' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd). Newcastle will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
40' Substitution. Jack Clarke walks off the pitch and Ben Godfrey (Ipswich) comes on as a substitute.
40' Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
40' Newcastle take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

40' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Newcastle.
37' Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) receives a second yellow card and is sent off.
36' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) wasted a golden chance to score after he found some space inside the box and unluckily volleyed the ball narrowly over the bar.

35' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) has a big opportunity to score! He climbs highest deep inside the penalty box and strikes a powerful header towards the goal. Next time he should aim better as his effort flies narrowly over the bar.
33' Julio Enciso (Ipswich) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
30' Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
30' Newcastle take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
30' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) looks relieved after the referee decides on no action against him after the VAR review.

29' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Samy Morsy (Ipswich), but referee Michael Salisbury must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
27' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) but poses no threat.
25' A cross from a corner kick by Newcastle is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
25' A cross into the box from Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) is cleared.
25' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee blows his whistle, Newcastle are awarded a corner kick.
24' One of the defending players blocks a long-range shot which was unleashed by Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd).
23' Goal disallowed! Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) scores but Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
19' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Newcastle.
18' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Now Newcastle have a corner.
15' Ipswich can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
14' A great run by Liam Delap (Ipswich) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender. Ipswich force a corner. They send men into the box.
10' The Newcastle players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ipswich comes to nothing.
4' Liam Delap (Ipswich) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Ipswich.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Ipswich will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Michael Salisbury.
